# Vendored: opencode-memory license

Only the upstream `LICENSE` is vendored here, and deliberately so: this
repository does not copy opencode-memory source files. It reproduces the
upstream logfmt store format — see `src/store/files/load.ts` — and extends
it, so the MIT attribution for the format is what has to ship. The upstream
project is `github.com/shuans/opencode-memory` (MIT, Copyright (c) 2025
Kris). Nothing else is missing from this directory.
